# A dependency directory is named after its Rocq library (for example, Metalib).
LIBRARIES := $(wildcard .rocq-deps/*)
LIBRARY_FLAGS := $(foreach lib,$(LIBRARIES),-R $(lib) $(notdir $(lib)))

.PHONY: all clean
all: Makefile.coq
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.coq

Makefile.coq: _CoqProject Makefile
	rocq makefile -f _CoqProject $(LIBRARY_FLAGS) -o Makefile.coq

clean:
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.coq clean

Require Import Relations Decidable.

Require Import Lists.

Require Import Forall2.

Require Import ZArith.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import RFJ.Utils.

Require Export Definitions.Syntax.

Require Export Definitions.Names.

Require Import Definitions.Semantics.

Require Import Definitions.SubDenotation.

Definition tybc (b:bool) : type :=
TRefn TBool (PCons (ExpBinOp (Eq) (Bc b) (BV 0))  PEmpty).

Definition tyic (n:Z) : type :=
TRefn TInt  (PCons (ExpBinOp (Eq) (Ic n) (BV 0))  PEmpty).

Definition refn_pred (c:UnOp) : expr :=
match c with
| Not      => (ExpBinOp (Eq) (ExpUnOp (Not) (BV 1)) (BV 0))
end.

Definition intype (c:UnOp) : type :=
match c with
| Not     => TRefn TBool   PEmpty
end.

Definition ty' (c:UnOp) : type :=
match c with
| Not      =>  TRefn TBool (PCons (refn_pred Not) PEmpty)
end.

Definition refn_pred2 (c:BinOp) : expr :=
match c with
| And      => (ExpBinOp (Eq) (ExpBinOp (And) (BV 2) (BV 1)) (BV 0))
| Or       => (ExpBinOp (Eq) (ExpBinOp (Or) (BV 2) (BV 1)) (BV 0))
| Eq       => (ExpBinOp (Eq) (ExpBinOp (Eq) (BV 2) (BV 1)) (BV 0))
end.

Definition intype2 (c:BinOp) : (type*type) :=
match c with
| And     => (TRefn TBool PEmpty, TRefn TBool PEmpty)
| Or      => (TRefn TBool PEmpty, TRefn TBool PEmpty)
| Eq      => (TRefn TAny PEmpty, TRefn TAny PEmpty)
end.

Definition ty'2 (c:BinOp) : type :=
match c with
| And      => (TRefn TBool (PCons (refn_pred2 And) PEmpty))
| Or       => (TRefn TBool (PCons (refn_pred2 Or)  PEmpty))
| Eq       => (TRefn TBool (PCons (refn_pred2 Eq)  PEmpty))
end.

Inductive HasFJtype : fjenv -> expr -> fjtype -> Prop :=
    | FTBC   : forall (g:fjenv) (b:bool),  HasFJtype g (Bc b) (TBool)
    | FTIC   : forall (g:fjenv) (n:Z),   HasFJtype g (Ic n) (TInt)
    | FTVar  : forall (g:fjenv) (x:vname) (b:fjtype),
        bound_inF x b g -> HasFJtype g (FV x) b
    | FTUnOP : forall (g:fjenv) (e:expr) (op: UnOp),
        HasFJtype g e (erase (intype op)) ->
        HasFJtype g (ExpUnOp op e) (erase (ty' op))
    | FTBinOP : forall (g:fjenv) (e1 e2:expr) (op: BinOp),
        HasFJtype g e1 (erase (fst (intype2 op))) -> HasFJtype g e2 (erase (snd (intype2 op))) ->
        HasFJtype g (ExpBinOp op e1 e2) (erase (ty'2 op))
    | FTInvok: forall (g:fjenv) (e1 :expr) (e2: expr) (m: MethodName) t rt C ps,
        HasFJtype g e1  (TNom (TClass C)) ->
        mtype(m, C) = ps ~> t ~> rt ->
        HasFJtype (g) e2 (erase t) ->
        HasFJtype g (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2) (erase rt)
    | FTInvokI: forall (g:fjenv) (e1 :expr) (e2: expr) (m: MethodName) t rt C ps,
        HasFJtype g e1 ((TNom (TInterface C))) ->
        mtypei(m, C) = ps ~> t ~> rt ->
        HasFJtype (g) e2 (erase t) ->
        HasFJtype g (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2) (erase rt)
    | FTField: forall g e f T C F i ff,
        HasFJtype g e ( (TNom (TClass C))) ->
        Reffields C F ->
        nth_error F i = Some ff ->
        ref ff = f ->
        ReffieldType ff = T ->
        HasFJtype g (ExpFieldAccess e f) (erase T)
    | FTNew:    forall g es C Fs Us fs,
        Us = map erase (map ReffieldType Fs) ->
        fs = map ReffieldName Fs ->
        Reffields C Fs ->
        Forall2 (HasFJtype g) es Us ->
        HasFJtype g (ExpNew C es) ((TNom (TClass C)))
    | FTLet  : forall (g:fjenv) (e_x:expr) (b:fjtype) (e:expr) (b':fjtype) (nms:names),
        HasFJtype g e_x b
            -> (forall (y:vname), ~ Elem y nms -> HasFJtype (FCons y b g) (unbind y e) b' )
            -> HasFJtype g (ExpLet e_x e) b'
    | FTSub  : forall (g:fjenv) (e:expr) (s:fjtype) (t:fjtype),
        HasFJtype g e s -> FJSubtype s t -> HasFJtype g e t
.

Inductive PIsBool : fjenv -> preds -> Prop :=
    | PFTEmp  : forall (g:fjenv), PIsBool g PEmpty
    | PFTCons : forall (g:fjenv) (p:expr) (ps:preds),
        HasFJtype g p (TBool) -> PIsBool g ps -> PIsBool g (PCons p ps).
Require Import RFJ.Lists.

Require Import RFJ.Utils.

Require Import Nat.

Require Import ZArith.

Notation "'[' X ']'" := (list X) (at level 40).

Definition index := nat.

Definition vname := nat.

Definition ClassName := nat.

Definition InterfaceName := nat.

Definition FieldName := nat.

Definition MethodName := nat.

Definition LblName := nat.

Parameter this: vname.

Parameter v: vname.

Inductive nomtype: Type :=
| TClass: ClassName -> nomtype
| TInterface: InterfaceName -> nomtype.

Inductive fjtype : Type :=
  | TAny
  | TBool
  | TInt
  | TNom: nomtype -> fjtype.

Inductive UnOp :=
  | Not.

Inductive BinOp :=
  | And
  | Or
  | Eq.

Inductive expr : Type :=
  | Bc (b : bool)
  | Ic (n : Z)
  | BV (i : index)
  | FV (x : vname)
  | ExpUnOp (o:UnOp) (e:expr)
  | ExpBinOp (o:BinOp) (e1:expr) (e2:expr)
  | ExpFieldAccess : expr -> FieldName -> expr
  | ExpMethodInvoc : expr -> MethodName -> expr -> expr
  | ExpNew : ClassName -> [expr] -> expr
  | ExpLet (e1 : expr) (e2 : expr)


with type:Type :=
  | TRefn   (b : fjtype) (ps : preds)


with preds : Type :=
  | PEmpty: preds
  | PCons (p : expr) (ps : preds).

Scheme expr_mutind  := Induction for expr  Sort Prop
with   type_mutind  := Induction for type  Sort Prop
with   preds_mutind := Induction for preds Sort Prop.

Fixpoint erase (t0 : type) : fjtype :=
  match t0 with
  | (TRefn b r)     => b
  end.

Fixpoint isValue (e: expr) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | Bc _          => True
  | Ic _          => True
  | ExpNew c es => (fix f (es': [expr]) := match es' with | nil => True | e::es''=> isValue e /\ (f es'') end) es
  | _             => False
  end.

Fixpoint isLC_at (j_x : index) (e : expr) {struct e}: Prop  :=
  match e with
  | (Bc _)         => True
  | (Ic _)         => True
  | (BV i)         => i < j_x
  | (FV _)         => True
  | (ExpUnOp _ e1)         => isLC_at j_x e1
  | (ExpBinOp _ e1 e2)         => isLC_at j_x e1 /\ isLC_at j_x e2
  | (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2)         => isLC_at j_x e1 /\ isLC_at j_x e2
  | (ExpFieldAccess e1 f) => isLC_at j_x e1
  | (ExpNew c es) => (fix f (es': [expr]) := match es' with | nil => True | e::es''=> isLC_at j_x e /\ (f es'') end) es
  | (ExpLet ex e')    => isLC_at j_x ex    /\ isLC_at (j_x+1) e'
  end

with isLCT_at (j_x : index) (t0 : type) {struct t0}: Prop :=
  match t0 with
  | (TRefn   b  rs) =>  match b with
                        | _       =>            isLCP_at (j_x+1) rs
                        end
  end

with isLCP_at (j_x : index) (ps0 : preds) {struct ps0}: Prop :=
  match ps0 with
  | PEmpty       => True
  | (PCons p ps) => isLC_at j_x p /\ isLCP_at j_x ps
  end.

Definition isLC  (e  : expr)  : Prop := isLC_at  0 e.

Definition isLCT (t  : type)  : Prop := isLCT_at 0 t.

Definition isLCP (ps : preds) : Prop := isLCP_at 0 ps.

Fixpoint open_at (j : index) (y : vname) (e : expr) {struct e} : expr :=
    match e with
    | (Bc b)             => Bc b
    | (Ic n)             => Ic n
    | (BV i)             => if j =? i then FV y else BV i
    | (FV x)             => FV x
    | (ExpUnOp op e')        => ExpUnOp op (open_at j y e')
    | (ExpBinOp op e1 e2)        => ExpBinOp op  (open_at j y e1)  (open_at j y e2)
    | (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2)        => ExpMethodInvoc (open_at j y e1) m (open_at j y e2)
    | (ExpFieldAccess e1 f) => ExpFieldAccess (open_at j y e1) f
    | (ExpNew c es) => ExpNew c ((fix f (es': [expr]) := match es' with | nil => nil | e::es''=> (open_at j y e) :: (f es'') end) es)
    | (ExpLet ex e')        => ExpLet   (open_at j y ex) (open_at (j+1) y e')
    end

with openT_at (j : index) (y : vname) (t0 : type)  {struct t0} : type :=
    match t0 with
    | (TRefn b ps)    => TRefn b (openP_at (j+1) y ps)
    end

with openP_at (j : index) (y : vname) (ps0 : preds)  {struct ps0} : preds  :=
    match ps0 with
    | PEmpty       => PEmpty
    | (PCons p ps) => PCons (open_at j y p) (openP_at j y ps)
    end.

Fixpoint open_many (l:[vname]) (e : expr)  : expr :=
  match l with
  | nil => e
  | v::l' => open_many l' (open_at ((length l) - 1) v e)
  end.

Definition unbind  (y : vname) (e : expr)   : expr  :=  open_at 0 y e.

Definition unbindT (y : vname) (t : type)   : type  :=  openT_at 0 y t.

Definition unbindP (y : vname) (ps : preds) : preds :=  openP_at 0 y ps.

Fixpoint subFV (x : vname) (v_x : expr) (e0 : expr) : expr :=
  match e0 with
  | (Bc b)                    => Bc b
  | (Ic n)                    => Ic n
  | (BV i)                    => BV i
  | (FV y)                    => if x =? y then v_x else FV y
  | (ExpUnOp op e)              => ExpUnOp op (subFV x v_x e)
  | (ExpBinOp op e e')                => ExpBinOp op (subFV x v_x e)  (subFV x v_x e')
  | (ExpMethodInvoc e m e')                => ExpMethodInvoc (subFV x v_x e) m (subFV x v_x e')
  | (ExpFieldAccess e1 f) => ExpFieldAccess (subFV x v_x e1) f
  | (ExpNew c es) => ExpNew c ((fix f (es': [expr]) := match es' with | nil => nil | e::es''=> (subFV x v_x e) :: (f es'') end) es)
  | (ExpLet   e1 e2)             => ExpLet   (subFV x v_x e1) (subFV x v_x e2)
  end

with tsubFV (x : vname) (v_x : expr) (t0 : type) : type :=
    match t0 with
    | (TRefn  b r)     => TRefn b   (psubFV x v_x r)
    end

with psubFV (x : vname) (v_x : expr) (ps0 : preds) : preds :=
    match ps0 with
    | PEmpty       => PEmpty
    | (PCons p ps) => PCons (subFV x v_x p) (psubFV x v_x ps)
    end.

Fixpoint strengthen (qs : preds) (rs : preds) : preds :=
    match qs with
    | PEmpty       => rs
    | (PCons p ps) => PCons p (strengthen ps rs)
    end.

Fixpoint subBV_at (j : index) (v : expr)  (e : expr) {struct e} : expr :=
  match e with
  | (Bc b)             => Bc b
  | (Ic n)             => Ic n
  | (BV i)             => if j =? i then v else BV i
  | (FV x)             => FV x
  | (ExpUnOp op e)         => ExpUnOp op (subBV_at j v e)
  | (ExpBinOp op e e')         => ExpBinOp op (subBV_at j v e)  (subBV_at j v e')
  | (ExpMethodInvoc e m e')         => ExpMethodInvoc (subBV_at j v e) m (subBV_at j v e')
  | (ExpFieldAccess e1 f) => ExpFieldAccess (subBV_at j v e1) f
  | (ExpNew c es) => ExpNew c ((fix f (es': [expr]) := match es' with | nil => nil | e::es''=> (subBV_at j v e) :: (f es'') end) es)
  | (ExpLet ex e)         => ExpLet   (subBV_at j v ex) (subBV_at (j+1) v e)
  end
with tsubBV_at (j : index) (v_x : expr) (t0 : type)  {struct t0} : type :=
    match t0 with
    | (TRefn b ps)    => TRefn b (psubBV_at (j+1) v_x ps)
    end

with psubBV_at (j : index) (v_x : expr) (ps0 : preds)  {struct ps0} : preds  :=
    match ps0 with
    | PEmpty       => PEmpty
    | (PCons p ps) => PCons (subBV_at j v_x p) (psubBV_at j v_x ps)
    end.

Fixpoint subBV_many (l:[expr]) (e : expr)  : expr :=
  match l with
  | nil => e
  | v::l' => subBV_many l' (subBV_at ((length l) - 1) v e)
  end.

Fixpoint tsubBV_many (l:[expr]) (t : type)  : type :=
  match l with
  | nil => t
  | v::l' => tsubBV_many l' (tsubBV_at ((length l) - 1) v t)
  end.

Definition subBV  (v : expr) (e : expr)   : expr  :=  subBV_at 0 v e.

Definition tsubBV (v_x : expr) (t : type) : type  :=  tsubBV_at 0 v_x t.

Definition psubBV (v : expr) (ps : preds) : preds :=  psubBV_at 0 v ps.

Definition eqlPred2 e1 e2:= ExpBinOp (Eq) e1 e2.

Definition eqlPred (e : expr) :=  ExpBinOp (Eq) e (BV 0).

Fixpoint self (t0 : type) (e : expr) : type :=
  match t0 with
  | (TRefn b ps)      =>  TRefn b (PCons  (eqlPred e)  ps)
  end.

Inductive RefFieldDecl :=
| RefFDecl : type -> FieldName -> RefFieldDecl.

#[export] Instance RefFieldRef: Referable RefFieldDecl :={
  ref fdecl :=
    match fdecl with
    | RefFDecl _ fn => fn end
}.

Definition ReffieldType (f: RefFieldDecl): type :=
  match f with RefFDecl t _ => t end.

Definition ReffieldName (f: RefFieldDecl): FieldName :=
  match f with RefFDecl _ n => n end.

Inductive Argument :=
| Arg : vname -> Argument.

Inductive Assignment :=
  | Assgnmt : expr -> expr -> Assignment.

Inductive Constructor :=
  | KDecl : ClassName -> [RefFieldDecl] -> [vname] -> [Assignment] -> Constructor.

Inductive MethodDecl :=
| MDecl : type -> MethodName -> preds -> type -> MethodDecl.

#[export] Instance MDeclRef : Referable MethodDecl :={
  ref mdecl :=
    match mdecl with
   | MDecl _ var _ _ => var end

Inductive MethodDefn :=
| MDefn : MethodDecl -> expr -> MethodDefn.

#[export] Instance MDefnRef : Referable MethodDefn :={
  ref mdecl :=
    match mdecl with
   | MDefn (MDecl _ var _ _) _ => var end
}.

Inductive RefClassDecl:=
| RefCDecl: ClassName -> ClassName -> [InterfaceName] ->
  forall (fDecls:[RefFieldDecl]), NoDup (refs fDecls) -> Constructor ->
  forall (mDefns:[MethodDefn]), NoDup (refs mDefns) -> RefClassDecl.

Inductive RefInterfaceDecl:=
| RefIDecl: InterfaceName ->
  forall (mDecls:[MethodDecl]), NoDup (refs mDecls) -> RefInterfaceDecl.

#[export] Instance RefCDeclRef : Referable RefClassDecl :={
  ref cdecl :=
    match cdecl with
    | RefCDecl var _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => var end
}.

    match cdecl with
   | RefIDecl var _ _ => var end

           WFtype g (TRefn b PEmpty)
    | WFRefn : forall (g : env) (b : fjtype) (ps : preds) (nms : names),

Inductive Hastype: env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=

  | TBC   : forall (g:env) (b:bool), Hastype g (Bc b) (tybc b)
  | TIC   : forall (g:env) (m:Z),  Hastype g (Ic m) (tyic m)
  | TUnOP  : forall (g:env) (e:expr) (op: UnOp) t,
        Hastype g e t -> Subtype g t (intype op) -> isLC e -> Hastype g (ExpUnOp op e) (tsubBV e (ty' op))
  | TBinOP : forall (g:env) (e1 e2:expr) (op: BinOp) t t',
        Hastype g e1 t ->
        (Subtype g t (fst (intype2 op))) ->
        Hastype g e2 t'->
        (Subtype g t' (tsubBV e1 (snd (intype2 op)))) ->
        isLC e1 -> isLC e2 ->
        Hastype g (ExpBinOp op e1 e2) (tsubBV_at 1 e1 (tsubBV e2 (ty'2 op)))
  | TVar  : forall (g:env) (x:vname) (t:type),
    bound_in x t g -> WFtype g t -> Hastype g (FV x) (self t (FV x))
  | TInvok: forall (g:env) (e1:expr) (e2: expr) (m: MethodName) t t' rt C ps ps',

        mtype(m, C) = ps ~> t ~> rt ->
        (Subtype g (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps') (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps)) ->
        (Hastype g e2 t') -> (Subtype g t' (tsubBV e1 t)) -> isLC e2 -> isLC e1 ->
        Hastype g (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2) (self (tsubBV_at 1 e1 (tsubBV e2 rt)) (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2))
  | TInvokI: forall (g:env) (e1:expr) (e2: expr) (m: MethodName) t t' rt I ps ps',
        Hastype g e1 (TRefn (TNom (TInterface I)) ps') ->
        mtypei(m, I) = ps ~> t ~> rt ->
        (Subtype g (TRefn (TNom (TInterface I)) ps') (TRefn (TNom (TInterface I)) ps)) ->
        (Hastype g e2 t') -> (Subtype g t' (tsubBV e1 t)) -> isLC e2 -> isLC e1 ->
        Hastype g (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2) (self (tsubBV_at 1 e1 (tsubBV e2 rt)) (ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2))
  | TField: forall g e f C Fs i fi ps,
                     isLC e ->
                    Hastype g e (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps) ->
                    Reffields C Fs ->
                    nth_error Fs i = Some fi ->
                    ref fi = f ->
                    Hastype g (ExpFieldAccess e f) (self (tsubBV e (ReffieldType fi)) (ExpFieldAccess e f))
  | TNew:    forall g es Ts C Fs Us fs,

    WFtype g b' -> Hastype g e_x b -> (forall (y:vname), ~ Elem y nms -> Hastype (Cons y b g) (unbind y e) (unbindT y b') )
    -> Hastype g (ExpLet e_x e) (self b' (ExpLet e_x e))

  | TSub  : forall (g:env) (e:expr) (s:type) (t:type),
                Hastype g e s -> WFtype g t -> Subtype g s t -> Hastype g e t

where " g '|---' e ':' C " := (Hastype g e C).

Definition Terminating g e:= forall th, DenotesEnv g th -> exists e', EvalsTo (csubst th e) e' /\ isValue e'.

Definition wf_under C Ds := (forall y,  WFtype (Cons y C Empty) (openT_at 0 y Ds)).

Definition wf_under2 C Cs Ds := (forall y y', y <> y' -> WFtype (Cons y' (openT_at 0 y Cs) (Cons y C Empty)) (openT_at 1 y (openT_at 0 y' Ds))).

Inductive SubClass: nomtype -> nomtype -> Prop :=
| SubCRefl : forall b, SubClass b b
| SubCTrans: forall b1 b2 b3, SubClass b1 b2 -> SubClass b2 b3 -> SubClass b1 b3
| SubCInh:   forall (C D:ClassName) Is fs noDupfs K mds noDupMds,
            find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is fs noDupfs K mds noDupMds ) ->
            SubClass  (TClass C) (TClass D)
| SubIInh:   forall (C D:ClassName) Is I fs noDupfs K mds noDupMds i,
            find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is fs noDupfs K mds noDupMds ) ->
            nth_error Is i = Some I ->
            SubClass (TClass C) (TInterface I).

Inductive FJSubtype: fjtype -> fjtype -> Prop :=
| SubBAny : forall t, FJSubtype t TAny
| SubBInt : FJSubtype TInt TInt
| SubBBool : FJSubtype TBool TBool
| SubBClass: forall C D, SubClass C D -> FJSubtype (TNom C) (TNom D).

Inductive csub : Set :=
    | CEmpty
    | CCons  (x : vname) (v_x : expr) (th : csub).

Fixpoint bindsC (th : csub) : names :=
    match th with
    | CEmpty            => empty
    | (CCons  x v_x th) => names_add x (bindsC th)
    end.

Definition in_csubst (x : vname) (th : csub) : Prop := Elem x (bindsC th).

Fixpoint bound_inC (x : vname) (v_x : expr) (th : csub) : Prop :=
    match th with
    | CEmpty             => False
    | (CCons  y v_y th)  => (x = y /\ v_x = v_y) \/ bound_inC x v_x th
    end.

Fixpoint closed (th0 : csub) : Prop :=
    match th0 with
    | CEmpty            => True
    | (CCons  x v_x th) => fv v_x = empty /\ closed th
    end.

Fixpoint loc_closed (th0 : csub) : Prop :=
    match th0 with
    | CEmpty            => True
    | (CCons  x v_x th) => isLC v_x /\ loc_closed th
    end.

Fixpoint substitutable (th0 : csub) : Prop :=
    match th0 with
    | CEmpty            => True
    | (CCons  x v_x th) => isValue v_x /\ substitutable th
    end.

Fixpoint uniqueC (th0 : csub) : Prop :=
    match th0 with
    | CEmpty         => True
    | (CCons  x v_x th) => ~ in_csubst x th /\ uniqueC th
    end.

Fixpoint csubst (th : csub) (e : expr) : expr :=
    match th with
    | CEmpty            => e
    | (CCons  x v_x th) => csubst th (subFV  x v_x e)
    end.

Fixpoint cpsubst (th : csub) (ps : preds) : preds :=
    match th with
    | CEmpty            => ps
    | (CCons  x v_x th) => cpsubst th (psubFV  x v_x ps)
    end.

Fixpoint ctsubst (th : csub) (t : type) : type :=
    match th with
    | CEmpty           => t
    | (CCons  x v  th) => ctsubst th (tsubFV x v t)
    end.

Fixpoint remove_fromCS (th:csub) (x:vname) : csub :=
    match th with
    | CEmpty          => CEmpty
    | (CCons  y v th) => if x =? y then th else CCons  y v (remove_fromCS th x)
    end.

Fixpoint csubst_env (th0:csub) (g:env) : env :=
    match th0 with
    | CEmpty            => g
    | (CCons  z v_z th) => csubst_env th (esubFV  z v_z g)
    end.

Fixpoint CconcatE (th th'0 : csub) : csub :=
    match th'0 with
    | CEmpty          => th
    | (CCons  x t th') => CCons  x t (CconcatE th th')
    end.

Inductive PEvalsTrue : preds -> Prop :=
    | PEEmp  : PEvalsTrue PEmpty
    | PECons : forall (p : expr) (ps : preds),
        EvalsTo p (Bc true) -> PEvalsTrue ps -> PEvalsTrue (PCons p ps).

Inductive Denotes: type -> expr -> Prop :=
| DenotesInt: forall ps i,
    PEvalsTrue (psubBV (Ic i) ps) -> Denotes (TRefn TInt ps) (Ic i)
| DenotesBool: forall ps bol,
    PEvalsTrue (psubBV (Bc bol) ps) -> Denotes (TRefn TBool ps) (Bc bol)
| DenotesClass: forall ps c es Fs, isValue (ExpNew c es) ->
    PEvalsTrue (psubBV (ExpNew c es) ps) ->
    Reffields c Fs -> Forall2 Denotes (map (tsubBV (ExpNew c es)) (map ReffieldType Fs)) (es) ->
    Denotes (TRefn (TNom (TClass c)) ps) (ExpNew c es)
| DenotesUpcast: forall b1 b ps v,
    Denotes (TRefn b1 ps) v -> FJSubtype b1 b ->
    Denotes (TRefn b ps) v.

Inductive DenotesEnv : env -> csub -> Prop :=
    | DEmp  : DenotesEnv Empty CEmpty
    | DExt  : forall (g:env) (th:csub) (x:vname) (t:type) (v:expr),
        DenotesEnv g th -> ~ in_env x g -> Denotes (ctsubst th t) v
              -> DenotesEnv (Cons x t g) (CCons x v th).

Inductive LImplies : env -> preds -> preds -> Prop :=
    | SImp : forall (g:env) (ps qs : preds),
        (forall (th:csub), DenotesEnv g th -> PEvalsTrue (cpsubst th ps)
                                           -> PEvalsTrue (cpsubst th qs) )
            -> LImplies g ps qs.

Definition LEntails g ps:= forall th, DenotesEnv g th -> PEvalsTrue (cpsubst th ps).

Reserved Notation "Gamma '|-s' T '<::' S" (at level 41).

Inductive Subtype: env-> type -> type -> Prop :=
    | SBase : forall (g:env) (b1 b2:fjtype) (p1:preds) (p2:preds) (nms:names),
    FJSubtype b1 b2 ->
    (forall (y:vname), ~ Elem y nms
                    -> LImplies (Cons y (TRefn b1 PEmpty) g) (unbindP y p1) (unbindP y p2))
        -> Subtype g (TRefn b1 p1) (TRefn b2 p2)

  where "Gamma '|-s' T '<::' S" := (Subtype Gamma T S).
Require Import Relations Decidable.

Require Import RFJ.Lists.

Require Import RFJ.Utils.Referable.

Require Import Forall2.

Require Import ZArith.

Require Import Bool.

Require Export Definitions.Syntax.

Require Export Definitions.Names.

Inductive isCompat : UnOp -> expr -> Set :=
    | isCpt_Not  : forall b, isCompat Not (Bc b).

Inductive isCompat2 : BinOp -> expr -> expr -> Set :=
| isCpt_And  : forall b1 b2, isCompat2 And (Bc b1) (Bc b2)
| isCpt_Or   : forall b1 b2, isCompat2 Or  (Bc b1) (Bc b2)
| isCpt_Eq  : forall v1 v2, isValue v1 -> isValue v2 -> isCompat2 Eq v1 v2.

Fixpoint veq v1 v2 :=
    match v1, v2 with
    | (Ic n1), (Ic n2) => Z.eqb n1 n2
    | (Bc n1), (Bc n2) => Bool.eqb n1 n2
    | (ExpNew c1 es1), (ExpNew c2 es2) => andb (c1 =? c2) ((fix ff es1' es2' :=
                                                    match es1' with
                                                    | nil => (match es2' with | nil => true | e2:: es2'' => false end)
                                                    | e1 :: es1'' => (match es2' with | nil => false | e2:: es2'' => andb (veq e1 e2) (ff es1'' es2'') end)
                                                    end) es1 es2)
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Definition udelta (c : UnOp) (v : expr) (pf : isCompat c v) : expr :=
  match pf with
  | isCpt_Not b    => match b with
                      | true  => Bc false
                      | false => Bc true
                      end
  end.

Definition udelta' (c : UnOp) (v : expr) : option expr :=
  match v with
  |(Bc b) => match b with
            | true  => Some (Bc false)
            | false => Some (Bc true)
            end
  | _     => None
  end.

Definition bdelta (c : BinOp) (v1 : expr) (v2 : expr) (pf : isCompat2 c v1 v2) : expr :=
  match pf with
  | isCpt_And b1 b2   => Bc (andb b1 b2)
  | isCpt_Or b1 b2    => Bc (orb b1 b2)
  | isCpt_Eq v1 v2 p1 p2 => Bc (veq v1 v2)

  end.

Definition bdelta' (c : BinOp) (v1 : expr) (v2 : expr) : option expr :=
  match c, v1, v2 with
  | And      , (Bc b1), (Bc b2) => Some  (Bc (andb b1 b2))
  | Or       , (Bc b1), (Bc b2) => Some  (Bc (orb b1 b2))
  | Eq       , _, _             => Some (Bc (veq v1 v2))
  | _        , _, _         => None
  end.

Inductive Reffields : ClassName -> [RefFieldDecl] -> Prop :=
| RefF_Obj : Reffields Object nil
| RefF_Decl : forall C D Is fs  noDupfs K mds noDupMds fs',
    find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is fs noDupfs K mds noDupMds) ->
    Reffields D fs' ->
    NoDup (refs (fs' ++ fs)) ->
    Reffields C (fs'++fs).

Reserved Notation "'mtype(' m ',' D ')' '=' ps '~>' c '~>' c0" (at level 40, c at next level).

Inductive m_type: MethodName -> ClassName -> preds -> type -> type -> Prop:=
  | mty_ok : forall C D Is m ps rt t e Fs K Ms noDupfs noDupMds,
              find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds)->
              find m Ms = Some (MDefn (MDecl rt m ps t) e) ->
              mtype(m, C) = ps ~> t ~> rt
  | mty_no_override: forall ps C D Is m rt t Fs K Ms noDupfs noDupMds,
              find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds) ->
              find m Ms = None ->
              mtype(m, D) = ps ~> t ~> rt ->
              mtype(m, C) = ps ~> t ~> rt
  where "'mtype(' m ',' D ')' '=' ps '~>' cs '~>' c0"
        := (m_type m D ps cs c0).

Reserved Notation "'mtypei(' m ',' I ')' '=' ps '~>' c '~>' c0" (at level 40, c at next level).

Inductive m_type_i: MethodName -> InterfaceName -> preds -> type -> type -> Prop:=
| mty_ok_i : forall I Ms m rt t ps noDupMds,
            find I RefIT = Some (RefIDecl I Ms noDupMds)->
            find m Ms = Some (MDecl rt m ps t) ->
            mtypei(m, I) = ps ~> t ~> rt
where "'mtypei(' m ',' I ')' '=' ps '~>' cs '~>' c0"
      := (m_type_i m I ps cs c0).

Inductive m_body: MethodName -> ClassName -> expr -> Prop:=
  | mbdy_ok : forall C D Is m ps rt t e Fs K Ms noDupfs noDupMds,
              find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds)->
              find m Ms = Some (MDefn (MDecl rt m ps t) e) ->
              m_body m C e
  | mbdy_no_override: forall C D Is m e Fs K Ms noDupfs noDupMds,
              find C RefCT = Some (RefCDecl C D Is Fs noDupfs K Ms noDupMds)->
              find m Ms = None ->
              m_body m D e ->
              m_body m C e.

Notation "'mbody(' m ',' D ')' '=' e" := (m_body m D e) (at level 40).

Reserved Notation "e '~~>' e1" (at level 60).

Inductive Step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| EUnOp1 : forall (c:UnOp) (e e': expr) ,
      Step e e' -> Step (ExpUnOp c e) (ExpUnOp c e')
| EUnOp2 : forall (c:UnOp) (w : expr) (pf : isCompat c w),
      isValue w -> Step (ExpUnOp c w) (udelta c w pf)
| EBinOp1 : forall (c:BinOp) (e e' e1 : expr),
      Step e e' -> Step (ExpBinOp c e e1) (ExpBinOp c e' e1)
| EBinOp2 : forall (c:BinOp) (e e' v : expr),
      isValue v -> Step e e' -> Step (ExpBinOp c v e) (ExpBinOp c v e')
| EBinOp3 : forall (c:BinOp) (v1 v2: expr) (pf : isCompat2 c v1 v2),
      isValue v1 -> isValue v2 -> Step (ExpBinOp c v1 v2) (bdelta c v1 v2 pf)
| Refc_Invok1: forall m e1 e2 e1',
      e1 ~~> e1' ->
      ExpMethodInvoc e1 m e2 ~~> ExpMethodInvoc e1' m e2
| Refc_Invok2: forall m v e e',
    isValue v -> e ~~> e' ->
    ExpMethodInvoc v m e ~~> ExpMethodInvoc v m e'
| Refc_Invok3: forall C e m v es,
    mbody(m, C) = e -> isValue v -> isValue (ExpNew C es) ->
    ExpMethodInvoc (ExpNew C es) m v ~~> (subBV_at 1 (ExpNew C es) (subBV v e))
| Refc_Field : forall C Fs es fi ei i,
      Reffields C Fs ->
      nth_error Fs i = Some fi ->
      nth_error es i = Some ei->
      isValue (ExpNew C es) ->
      ExpFieldAccess (ExpNew C es) (ref fi) ~~> ei
| RefRC_Field : forall e0 e0' f,
      e0 ~~> e0' ->
      ExpFieldAccess e0 f ~~> ExpFieldAccess e0' f
| RefRC_New_Arg : forall C ei' es es' ei i,
      Step ei ei' ->
      nth_error es i = Some ei ->
      nth_error es' i = Some ei' ->
      (forall j, j <> i -> nth_error es j = nth_error es' j) ->
      length es = length es' ->
      ExpNew C es ~~> ExpNew C es'
| ELet  : forall (e_x e_x' e : expr),
      Step e_x e_x' -> Step (ExpLet e_x e) (ExpLet e_x' e)
| ELetV : forall (v : expr) (e : expr),
      isValue v -> Step (ExpLet v e) (subBV v e)
  where "e '~~>' e1" := (Step e e1).

Inductive EvalsTo : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
  | Refl     : forall (e : expr),  EvalsTo e e
  | AddStep  : forall (e1 e2 e3 : expr),
        Step e1 e2 -> EvalsTo e2 e3 -> EvalsTo e1 e3.

Local Lemma ls_fields_unique c fs gs :
  Reffields c fs -> Reffields c gs -> fs = gs.
Proof.
  intros F; revert gs; induction F; intros gs G; inversion G; subst; auto.
  - rewrite obj_notin_dom in H; discriminate.
  - rewrite obj_notin_dom in H; discriminate.
  - match goal with
    | A : find ?C RefCT = Some _, B : find ?C RefCT = Some _ |- _ =>
        rewrite A in B; injection B; intros; subst
    end.
    f_equal; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_body_unique m c body body' :
  m_body m c body -> m_body m c body' -> body = body'.
Proof.
  intros H; revert body'; induction H; intros body' H'; inversion H'; subst;
    match goal with
    | A : find ?C RefCT = Some _, B : find ?C RefCT = Some _ |- _ =>
        rewrite A in B; injection B; intros; subst
    end; try congruence; eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_nth2 {A B} (P : A -> B -> Prop) xs ys i x :
  Forall2 P xs ys -> nth_error xs i = Some x ->
  exists y, nth_error ys i = Some y /\\ P x y.
Proof.
  intros H; revert i; induction H; intros [|i] E; simpl in E; try discriminate; eauto.
  inversion E; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_find_in {A} {R : Referable A} k (xs : list A) x :
  find k xs = Some x -> In x xs.
Proof.
  induction xs as [|a xs IH]; simpl; try discriminate.
  destruct (k =? ref a)%nat; [intro E; inversion E; auto|auto].
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_nodup_nth {A} (xs : list A) i j x :
  NoDup xs -> nth_error xs i = Some x -> nth_error xs j = Some x -> i = j.
Proof.
  intros N; revert i j; induction N; intros [|i] [|j] E F; simpl in *;
    try discriminate; auto.
  - inversion E; subst. exfalso; apply H. eapply nth_error_In; eauto.
  - inversion F; subst. exfalso; apply H. eapply nth_error_In; eauto.
  - f_equal; eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_field_index c fs gs i j fi fj :
  Reffields c fs -> Reffields c gs ->
  nth_error fs i = Some fi -> nth_error gs j = Some fj ->
  ref fi = ref fj -> i = j.
Proof.
  intros F G A B E. pose proof (ls_fields_unique _ _ _ F G); subst gs.
  eapply ls_nodup_nth with (xs := refs fs) (x := ref fi).
  - inversion F; subst; [constructor|assumption].
  - unfold refs; now rewrite nth_error_map, A.
  - unfold refs; now rewrite nth_error_map, B, <- E.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_eval_unique n :
  forall e v, ls_eval n e v -> forall k w, ls_eval k e w -> v = w.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros e v E k w F; [inversion E|].
  inversion E; subst; inversion F; subst; auto.
  all: repeat match goal with
       | A : ls_eval n ?e ?v, B : ls_eval ?k ?e ?w |- _ =>
           first [constr_eq A B; fail 1 |
             constr_eq v w; fail 1 |
             let K := fresh in pose proof (IH _ _ A _ _ B) as K;
             first [progress subst | injection K; intros; clear K; subst]]
       end; try congruence.
  - f_equal.
    match goal with A : Forall2 (ls_eval n) ?es ?vs |- _ => revert vs0 H4; induction A end.
    + intros; inversion H4; auto.
    + intros; inversion H4; subst. f_equal; eauto.
  - assert (i = i0) by (eapply ls_field_index; eauto; congruence). subst. congruence.
  - assert (body = body0) by (eapply ls_body_unique; eauto). subst.
    eapply IH; eauto.
  - eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_delta_un o a (pf : isCompat o a) :
  udelta' o a = Some (udelta o a pf).
Proof. destruct pf; destruct b; reflexivity. Qed.

Local Lemma ls_delta_bin o a b (pf : isCompat2 o a b) :
  bdelta' o a b = Some (bdelta o a b pf).
Proof. destruct pf; reflexivity. Qed.

Local Lemma ls_delta_un' o a r :
  udelta' o a = Some r -> Step (ExpUnOp o a) r.
Proof.
  destruct o, a; simpl; try discriminate.
  destruct b; intro E; inversion E; apply (EUnOp2 _ _ (isCpt_Not _)); exact I.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_delta_bin' o a b r :
  isValue a -> isValue b -> bdelta' o a b = Some r -> Step (ExpBinOp o a b) r.
Proof.
  intros Va Vb; destruct o.
  - destruct a, b; simpl; try discriminate. intro E; inversion E.
    apply (EBinOp3 _ _ _ (isCpt_And _ _)); exact I.
  - destruct a, b; simpl; try discriminate. intro E; inversion E.
    apply (EBinOp3 _ _ _ (isCpt_Or _ _)); exact I.
  - cbn; intro E; inversion E. apply (EBinOp3 _ _ _ (isCpt_Eq _ _ Va Vb)); assumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_trans e d r : EvalsTo e d -> EvalsTo d r -> EvalsTo e r.
Proof. intros E F; induction E; eauto using EvalsTo. Qed.

Local Lemma ls_context (f : expr -> expr) :
  (forall e d, Step e d -> Step (f e) (f d)) ->
  forall e d, EvalsTo e d -> EvalsTo (f e) (f d).
Proof. intros H e d E; induction E; eauto using EvalsTo. Qed.

Local Lemma ls_step_new c (pre suf : list expr) a b :
  Step a b -> Step (ExpNew c (pre ++ a :: suf)) (ExpNew c (pre ++ b :: suf)).
Proof.
  intro H. eapply RefRC_New_Arg with (i := length pre); eauto.
  - rewrite nth_error_app2 by lia. now rewrite Nat.sub_diag.

Proof.

Local Lemma ls_body_unique m c body body' :

Proof.

    match goal with

Proof.
  intros H; revert i; induction H; intros [|i] E; simpl in E; try discriminate; eauto.
  inversion E; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Proof.

  destruct (k =? ref a)%nat; [intro E; inversion E; auto|auto].
Qed.

  Forall2 ls_runs es vs -> exists n, Forall2 (ls_eval n) es vs.

Proof. intros [n H] D; exists (S n); eauto using ls_un. Qed.

  - eapply ls_eval_le; [apply Nat.le_max_l|eassumption].
  - eapply ls_eval_le; [|eassumption]. eapply Nat.le_trans; [apply Nat.le_max_l|apply Nat.le_max_r].
  - eapply ls_eval_le; [|eassumption]. eapply Nat.le_trans; [apply Nat.le_max_r|apply Nat.le_max_r].
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_run_let e d a r :
  ls_runs e a -> ls_runs (subBV a d) r -> ls_runs (ExpLet e d) r.
Proof.
  intros [n H] [k F]. exists (S (max n k)); eapply ls_let;
    eauto using ls_eval_le, Nat.le_max_l, Nat.le_max_r.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_value_result n e r :
  isValue e -> ls_eval n e r -> r = e.
Proof.
  intros V E. destruct (ls_value_runs _ V) as [j J]. eapply ls_eval_unique; eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_patch es ds vs i a b :
  nth_error es i = Some a -> nth_error ds i = Some b ->
  (forall j, j <> i -> nth_error es j = nth_error ds j) ->
  length es = length ds ->
  (forall u, ls_runs b u -> ls_runs a u) ->
  Forall2 ls_runs ds vs -> Forall2 ls_runs es vs.
Proof.
  revert es ds vs; induction i; intros [|e es] [|d ds] vs A B Same Len P F;
    simpl in A, B; try discriminate;
    inversion F as [|? ? ? ? R Rs]; subst.
  - constructor; [auto|].
    assert (es = ds) as ->.
    { apply nth_error_ext. intro j. exact (Same (S j) ltac:(lia)). }
    exact Rs.
  - assert (e = d) as -> by (specialize (Same 0 ltac:(lia)); cbn in Same; congruence).
    constructor; [exact R|].
    eapply IHi; eauto.
    + intros j J; exact (Same (S j) ltac:(lia)).
    + simpl in Len; lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_step_back e d :
  Step e d -> forall r, ls_runs d r -> ls_runs e r.
Proof.
  intro S; induction S; intros r [n E];
    try solve [inversion E; subst; eauto 8 using ls_run_un, ls_run_bin, ls_run_field, ls_run_call, ls_run_let, ex_intro].
  - assert (isValue (udelta c w pf)).
    { destruct pf; destruct b; exact I. }
    pose proof (ls_value_result _ _ _ H0 E); subst.
    eapply ls_run_un; eauto using ls_value_runs, ls_delta_un.
  - assert (isValue (bdelta c v1 v2 pf)) by (destruct pf; exact I).
    pose proof (ls_value_result _ _ _ H1 E); subst.
    eapply ls_run_bin; eauto using ls_value_runs, ls_delta_bin.
  - eapply ls_run_call; eauto using ls_value_runs, ex_intro.
  - assert (isValue ei).
    { apply ls_values_new in H2. eapply Forall_forall; eauto using nth_error_In. }
    pose proof (ls_value_result _ _ _ H3 E); subst.
    eapply ls_run_field; eauto using ls_value_runs.
  - inversion E; subst. apply ls_run_new.
    eapply ls_patch; eauto.
    eapply ls_forall2_map_rel; [|eassumption]. intros; eexists; eassumption.
  - eapply ls_run_let; eauto using ls_value_runs, ex_intro.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_small_eval e r :
  EvalsTo e r -> isValue r -> ls_runs e r.
Proof. intros H V; induction H; eauto using ls_value_runs, ls_step_back. Qed.

item.text: The operational lemmas now connect the supplied small-step semantics to an evaluation relation that supports induction on terminating runs. I’ll use that relation to prove that refinements are preserved when evaluated expressions replace their values.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat >> Task.v <<'EOF'

Local Lemma ls_bv_reflect e :
  forall j k w, j <= k ->
  isLC_at k (subBV_at j w e) -> isLC_at (S k) e.
Proof.
  induction e using ls_expr_ind; intros j k w J L; cbn [subBV_at isLC_at] in *;
    try solve [intuition eauto].
  - destruct (j =? i)%nat eqn:E.
    + apply Nat.eqb_eq in E; lia.
    + cbn in L; lia.
  - induction H; cbn in *; intuition eauto.
  - destruct L as [L1 L2]. split; eauto.
    replace (S k + 1) with (S (k + 1)) by lia. eapply IHe2; eauto; lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_lc_new k c es :
  isLC_at k (ExpNew c es) <-> Forall (isLC_at k) es.
Proof.
  induction es; cbn [isLC_at].
  - split; intro; constructor.
  - change ((isLC_at k a /\\ isLC_at k (ExpNew c es)) <-> Forall (isLC_at k) (a :: es)).
    rewrite IHes. split; [intros []; constructor|intro H; inversion H]; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_eval_lc n :
  forall e r, ls_eval n e r -> isLC e.
Proof.
  unfold isLC. induction n as [|n IH]; intros e r H; inversion H; subst; cbn [isLC_at]; eauto.
  - change (isLC_at 0 (ExpNew c es)). apply ls_lc_new.
    match goal with F : Forall2 _ _ _ |- _ => clear H; induction F end;
      constructor; eauto.
  - split; eauto. replace (0+1) with (S 0) by lia.
    eapply ls_bv_reflect with (j := 0); [lia|eauto].
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_veq_refl e : isValue e -> veq e e = true.
Proof.
  induction e using ls_expr_ind; intro V; try contradiction.
  - destruct b; reflexivity.
  - cbn; apply Z.eqb_refl.
  - cbn [veq]. rewrite Nat.eqb_refl. simpl.
    apply ls_values_new in V.
    induction H as [|a es Ha Hes IH]; inversion V as [|? ? Va Ves]; subst; cbn; auto.
    now rewrite (Ha Va), (IH Ves).
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_eq_runs e d v :
  ls_runs e v -> ls_runs d v -> EvalsTo (ExpBinOp Eq e d) (Bc true).
Proof.
  intros [n E] F. eapply ls_run_bin with (b := v) in F; [|now exists n|].
  - destruct F as [j J]; eauto using ls_eval_small.
  - cbn; now rewrite ls_veq_refl by (eapply ls_eval_value; eassumption).
Qed.

(* A congruence whose leaves may replace two closed expressions that
   terminate at the same value. Bound variables can remain in the context. *)
Inductive ls_equiv : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| ls_eq_leaf : forall e d r, ls_runs e r -> ls_runs d r -> ls_equiv e d
| ls_eq_same : forall e, ls_equiv e e
| ls_eq_un : forall o e d, ls_equiv e d -> ls_equiv (ExpUnOp o e) (ExpUnOp o d)
| ls_eq_bin : forall o e d e' d', ls_equiv e e' -> ls_equiv d d' ->
    ls_equiv (ExpBinOp o e d) (ExpBinOp o e' d')
| ls_eq_field : forall e d f, ls_equiv e d -> ls_equiv (ExpFieldAccess e f) (ExpFieldAccess d f)
| ls_eq_call : forall e d e' d' m, ls_equiv e e' -> ls_equiv d d' ->
    ls_equiv (ExpMethodInvoc e m d) (ExpMethodInvoc e' m d')
| ls_eq_new : forall c es ds, Forall2 ls_equiv es ds ->
    ls_equiv (ExpNew c es) (ExpNew c ds)
| ls_eq_let : forall e d e' d', ls_equiv e e' -> ls_equiv d d' ->
    ls_equiv (ExpLet e d) (ExpLet e' d').

Local Lemma ls_equiv_sub e :
  forall d j v w, ls_equiv e d -> ls_equiv v w ->
    ls_equiv (subBV_at j v e) (subBV_at j w d).
Proof.
  induction e using ls_expr_ind; intros d' j u w E V;
    let K := fresh \"B\" in
    assert (K : ls_equiv (subBV_at j u ltac:(lazymatch type of E with ls_equiv ?a _ => exact a end))
                         (subBV_at j w ltac:(lazymatch type of E with ls_equiv ?a _ => exact a end)))
      by (cbn [subBV_at]; try destruct (j =? i)%nat; auto using ls_equiv);
    inversion E; subst; cbn [subBV_at] in *; auto using ls_equiv.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | A : ls_runs ?e ?r, B : ls_runs ?d ?r |- _ =>
       destruct A as [n A]; destruct B as [k B];
       rewrite "'!ls_bv_unused by (eapply ls_eval_lc; eassumption);
       eapply ls_eq_leaf; eexists; eassumption
    end].
  all: try solve [apply ls_eq_new; induction H; cbn; constructor; auto].
  - apply ls_eq_new. match goal with F : Forall2 _ _ _ |- _ =>
      revert ds F; induction H; intros ds F; inversion F; subst; cbn; constructor; auto
    end.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_equiv_runs n :
  forall e r, ls_eval n e r -> forall d, ls_equiv e d -> ls_runs d r.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros e r E d Q; [inversion E|].
  inversion Q; subst; [|now exists (S n)|..].

Local Lemma ls_sem_sub g s t :
  Subtype g s t ->
  forall th v, DenotesEnv g th -> Denotes (ctsubst th s) v -> Denotes (ctsubst th t) v.
Proof.
  intros S0; destruct S0 as [g b1 b2 p1 p2 nms Sub Imp].
  intros th v D V. rewrite "'!ls_cpsubst_refn in *.
  set (x := fresh (nms ++ binds g ++ fvP p1 ++ fvP p2)).
  assert (Fresh : ~ Elem x (nms ++ binds g ++ fvP p1 ++ fvP p2)) by apply ls_fresh.
  unfold Elem, set_In in Fresh. rewrite !in_app_iff in Fresh.
  assert (X : ~ in_env x g) by (unfold in_env; tauto).
  assert (A : ~ Elem x (fvP p1)) by tauto.
  assert (B : ~ Elem x (fvP p2)) by tauto.
  destruct (Imp x ltac:(tauto)) as [g'"' p' q' H].
  pose proof (ls_denotes_empty _ _ _ V) as V0.
  assert (D' : DenotesEnv (Cons x (TRefn b1 PEmpty) g) (CCons x v th)).
  { constructor; auto. rewrite ls_cpsubst_refn.
    replace (cpsubst th PEmpty) with PEmpty by (induction th; cbn; auto).
    exact V0. }
  specialize (H _ D'). cbn [cpsubst] in H. unfold unbindP in H.
  rewrite ls_popen_sub, ls_popen_sub in H by assumption.
  rewrite "'!(ls_cpsubst_bv _ _ D), ls_csubst_value in H by (eapply ls_denotes_value; eassumption).
  eapply DenotesUpcast; [|exact Sub].
  eapply ls_denotes_change; [exact V|].
  apply H. eapply ls_denotes_preds; eassumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_cpsubst_cons th e ps :
  cpsubst th (PCons e ps) = PCons (csubst th e) (cpsubst th ps).
Proof. revert e ps; induction th; cbn; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma ls_csubst_un th o e :
  csubst th (ExpUnOp o e) = ExpUnOp o (csubst th e).
Proof. revert e; induction th; cbn; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma ls_csubst_bin th o e d :
  csubst th (ExpBinOp o e d) = ExpBinOp o (csubst th e) (csubst th d).
Proof. revert e d; induction th; cbn; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma ls_csubst_field th e f :
  csubst th (ExpFieldAccess e f) = ExpFieldAccess (csubst th e) f.
Proof. revert e; induction th; cbn; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma ls_csubst_call th e m d :
  csubst th (ExpMethodInvoc e m d) = ExpMethodInvoc (csubst th e) m (csubst th d).
Proof. revert e d; induction th; cbn; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma ls_csubst_let th e d :
  csubst th (ExpLet e d) = ExpLet (csubst th e) (csubst th d).
Proof. revert e d; induction th; cbn; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma ls_csubst_new th c es :
  csubst th (ExpNew c es) = ExpNew c (map (csubst th) es).
Proof.
  revert es; induction th; intro es; cbn [csubst subFV].
  - now rewrite map_id.
  - rewrite IHth. f_equal. rewrite <- map_map. f_equal.
    induction es; cbn; congruence.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_csubst_BV th j : csubst th (BV j) = BV j.
Proof. induction th; cbn; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma ls_cpsubst_empty th : cpsubst th PEmpty = PEmpty.
Proof. induction th; cbn; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma ls_denotes_self th t e r :
  Denotes (ctsubst th t) r ->
  ls_runs (csubst th e) r ->
  Denotes (ctsubst th (self t e)) r.
Proof.
  destruct t as [b ps]; intros D E.
  rewrite ls_cpsubst_refn in D. rewrite ls_cpsubst_refn, ls_cpsubst_cons.
  cbn [self eqlPred] in *. 
  (* Expose the equality predicate introduced by selfification. *)
  change (Denotes (TRefn b (cpsubst th (PCons (ExpBinOp Eq e (BV 0)) ps))) r).
  rewrite ls_cpsubst_cons, ls_csubst_bin, ls_csubst_BV.
  eapply ls_denotes_change; [exact D|].
  unfold psubBV; cbn [psubBV_at subBV_at].
  rewrite ls_bv_unused by (destruct E as [n H]; eapply ls_eval_lc; eassumption).
  constructor.
  - eapply ls_eq_runs; [exact E|apply ls_value_runs; eauto using ls_denotes_value].
  - eapply ls_denotes_preds; eassumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_denotes_replace j t e d r :
  ls_equiv e d ->
  Denotes (tsubBV_at j e t) r -> Denotes (tsubBV_at j d t) r.
Proof.
  destruct t; intros Q D; cbn [tsubBV_at] in *.
  eapply ls_denotes_change; [exact D|].
  pose proof (ls_denotes_preds _ _ _ D) as P.
  unfold psubBV in *.
  (* The substituted expression may itself contain bound variables only
     in unchanged subterms. Use the congruence after instantiating self. *)
  eapply ls_replace_pred in P; [|exact Q].
  clear P.
  revert D; generalize (j + 1) as k; clear j.
  induction ps; intros k D.
  - constructor.
  - (* Instantiation of both placeholders is handled by the expression congruence. *)
    pose proof (ls_denotes_preds _ _ _ D) as P. cbn [psubBV_at] in *.
    inversion P; subst. constructor.
    + match goal with E : EvalsTo _ _ |- _ => destruct (ls_small_eval _ _ E I) as [n H] end.
      eapply ls_equiv_runs in H.
      * destruct H; eauto using ls_eval_small.
      * eapply ls_equiv_sub; [eapply ls_sub_same; exact Q|constructor].
    + apply IHps with (k := k).
      eapply ls_denotes_change; eassumption.
Qed.
EOF

PY

Proof.

Local Definition ls_fj_scope g e :=

Local Lemma ls_fj_scoped g e b : HasFJtype g e b -> ls_fj_scope g e.
Proof.
  revert g e b; fix IH 4; intros g e b T.
  destruct T; unfold ls_fj_scope; unfold isLC; cbn [isLC_at fv];
    try solve [split; [exact I|intros x F; inversion F]].
  - split; [exact I|]. intros y F; apply ls_add in F as [->|F]; [eapply ls_fj_bound; eassumption|inversion F].
  - exact (IH _ _ _ T).
  - destruct (IH _ _ _ T1), (IH _ _ _ T2).

  - destruct (IH _ _ _ T1), (IH _ _ _ T2).
    split; [auto|intros x F; apply ls_union in F; tauto].
  - destruct (IH _ _ _ T1), (IH _ _ _ T2).

    clear H H0 H1.
    revert es Us H2.
    fix Fields 3. intros es Us H2.
    destruct H2 as [|e t es ts Ht Hts].
    + split; [exact I|intros x F; inversion F].
    + destruct (IH _ _ _ Ht) as [L F], (Fields _ _ Hts) as [Ls Fs].
      split.
      * change (isLC e /\\ isLC (ExpNew C es)); auto.
      * intros x N. change (Elem x (union (fv e) (fv (ExpNew C es)))) in N.
        apply ls_union in N; tauto.
  - destruct (IH _ _ _ T) as [L F].
    split.
    + split; [exact L|].
      destruct (IH _ _ _ (H (fresh nms) (ls_fresh nms))) as [Ld _].
      unfold isLC, unbind in Ld. rewrite ls_open_as_bv in Ld.
      eapply ls_bv_reflect with (j := 0); [lia|exact Ld].
    + intros x N. apply ls_union in N as [N|N]; [now apply F|].
      set (y := fresh (x :: nms)).
      assert (Nfy : ~ Elem y (x :: nms)) by apply ls_fresh.
      change (~ (x = y \\/ Elem y nms)) in Nfy.
      destruct (IH _ _ _ (H y ltac:(tauto))) as [_ Fd].
      unfold unbind in Fd. rewrite ls_open_as_bv in Fd.
      specialize (Fd x (ls_fv_preserve_bv _ _ _ _ N)).
      unfold in_envFJ in Fd; cbn [bindsFJ] in Fd. apply ls_add in Fd. tauto.
  - exact (IH _ _ _ T).
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_fj_preds_lc g ps :
  PIsBool g ps -> isLCP_at 0 ps.
Proof.
  induction 1; cbn; auto. split; auto. exact (proj1 (ls_fj_scoped _ _ _ H)).
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_open_preds_lc ps x :
  isLCP_at 0 (unbindP x ps) -> isLCP_at 1 ps.
Proof.
  unfold unbindP. induction ps; cbn; auto. intros [L LP].
  split; auto. rewrite ls_open_as_bv in L.
  eapply ls_bv_reflect with (j := 0); eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_wf_lc g b ps :
  WFtype g (TRefn b ps) -> isLCP_at 1 ps.
Proof.
  intro W; inversion W; subst; [exact I|].
  eapply ls_open_preds_lc.
  apply ls_fj_preds_lc with (g := FCons (fresh nms) b (erase_env g)).
  eauto using ls_fresh.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_fj_preds_fv g ps :
  PIsBool g ps -> forall x, Elem x (fvP ps) -> in_envFJ x g.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros x F; cbn [fvP] in F; [inversion F|].
  apply ls_union in F as [F|F]; auto.
  exact (proj2 (ls_fj_scoped _ _ _ H) _ F).
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_fv_preserve_openP ps y k x :
  Elem x (fvP ps) -> Elem x (fvP (openP_at k y ps)).
Proof.
  induction ps; cbn [fvP openP_at]; auto.
  setoid_rewrite ls_union. rewrite ls_open_as_bv.
  intuition eauto using ls_fv_preserve_bv.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_wf_empty_fv b ps :
  WFtype Empty (TRefn b ps) -> forall x, ~ Elem x (fvP ps).
Proof.
  intros W x F; inversion W; subst; [inversion F|].
  set (y := fresh (x :: nms)).
  assert (N : ~ Elem y (x :: nms)) by apply ls_fresh.
  change (~ (x = y \\/ Elem y nms)) in N.
  match goal with P : forall y, ~ Elem y nms -> _ |- _ =>
    pose proof (ls_fj_preds_fv _ _ (P y ltac:(tauto)) _
      (ls_fv_preserve_openP _ y 0 _ F)) as In
  end.
  unfold in_envFJ in In; cbn [bindsFJ] in In.
  apply ls_add in In as [E|E]; [tauto|inversion E].
Qed.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat >> Task.v <<'EOF'

Local Lemma ls_method_ok c d is fs nf k ms nm m ps t rt body :
  find c RefCT = Some (RefCDecl c d is fs nf k ms nm) ->
  find m ms = Some (MDefn (MDecl rt m ps t) body) ->
  MType_OK c (MDefn (MDecl rt m ps t) body).
Proof.
  intros C M. pose proof (cok _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ C) as OK.
  inversion OK; subst.
  match goal with F : Forall (MType_OK _) _ |- _ =>
    eapply Forall_forall; [exact F|eapply ls_find_in; exact M]
  end.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_find_key {A} {R : Referable A} k (xs : list A) a :
  find k xs = Some a -> ref a = k.
Proof.
  induction xs as [|b xs IH]; cbn [find]; try discriminate.
  destruct (k =? ref b)%nat eqn:E; auto.
  intro H; inversion H; subst. apply Nat.eqb_eq in E; congruence.
Qed.

Local Inductive ls_sig : MethodName -> nomtype -> preds -> type -> type -> Prop :=
| ls_sig_c : forall m c ps t rt, mtype(m,c) = ps ~> t ~> rt ->
    ls_sig m (TClass c) ps t rt
| ls_sig_i : forall m i ps t rt, mtypei(m,i) = ps ~> t ~> rt ->
    ls_sig m (TInterface i) ps t rt.

Local Lemma ls_signature_closed m b ps t rt :
  ls_sig m b ps t rt ->
  WFtype Empty (TRefn (TNom b) ps) /\\ free t = empty /\\ free rt = empty.
Proof.
  intro S; destruct S as [m c ps t rt S|m i ps t rt S].
  - induction S.
    + pose proof (ls_method_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H H0) as OK.
      inversion OK; subst; auto.
    + destruct IHS as [W [T R]]. repeat split; auto.
      inversion W; subst; [constructor|].
      eapply WFRefn; eauto using WFBase.
  - inversion S; subst.
    pose proof (iok _ _ _ H) as OK. inversion OK; subst.
    match goal with F : Forall (MType_OK_I _) _ |- _ =>
      pose proof (proj1 (Forall_forall _ _) F _ (ls_find_in _ _ _ H0)) as M;
      inversion M; subst; auto
    end.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_ctsubst_empty_free th t :
  free t = empty -> ctsubst th t = t.
Proof. intro E; apply ls_ctsubst_closed; intro x; rewrite E; intro F; inversion F. Qed.

Local Definition ls_sound_at n :=
  forall g e t th r, Hastype g e t -> DenotesEnv g th ->
  ls_eval n (csubst th e) r -> Denotes (ctsubst th t) r.

Local Lemma ls_body_checked n m c ps t rt :
  ls_sound_at n ->
  mtype(m,c) = ps ~> t ~> rt ->
  exists body, m_body m c body /\\
  forall recv a r,
    Denotes (TRefn (TNom (TClass c)) ps) recv ->
    Denotes (tsubBV recv t) a ->
    ls_eval n (subBV_at 1 recv (subBV a body)) r ->
    Denotes (ls_result recv a rt) r.
Proof.
  intros IH M; induction M.
  - exists e; split; [eapply mbdy_ok; eassumption|].
    pose proof (ls_method_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H H0) as OK.
    inversion OK; subst.
    intros recv a r Rec Arg Run.
    assert (ArgV : isValue a) by (eapply ls_denotes_value; exact Arg).
    assert (D : DenotesEnv (Cons 0 (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps) Empty)
                           (CCons 0 recv CEmpty)) by (constructor; auto using DEmp).
    assert (D' : DenotesEnv
      (Cons 1 (openT_at 0 0 t) (Cons 0 (TRefn (TNom (TClass C)) ps) Empty))
      (CCons 1 a (CCons 0 recv CEmpty))).
    { constructor; auto.
      - unfold in_env; cbn [binds]; rewrite ls_add; intros [E|E]; [discriminate|inversion E].
      - destruct t; cbn [ctsubst openT_at tsubFV].
        rewrite ls_popen_sub; [exact Arg|].
        match goal with F : free (TRefn _ _) = empty |- _ =>
          cbn [free] in F; rewrite F; intro E; inversion E
        end. }
    match goal with T : forall y y', y <> y' -> Hastype _ _ _ |- _ =>
      pose proof (IH _ _ _ _ r (T 0 1 ltac:(discriminate)) D') as Sound
    end.
    cbn [csubst] in Sound.
    rewrite ls_two_open in Sound by (try discriminate; try assumption;
      match goal with F : fv e = empty |- _ => rewrite F; intro E; inversion E end).
    specialize (Sound Run). destruct rt; cbn [openT_at ctsubst tsubFV] in Sound.
    rewrite ls_two_openP in Sound by (try discriminate; try assumption;
      match goal with F : free (TRefn _ _) = empty |- _ =>
        cbn [free] in F; rewrite F; intro E; inversion E
      end).
    exact Sound.
  - destruct IHM as [body [B Safe]]. exists body; split.
    + eapply mbdy_no_override; eassumption.
    + intros recv a r Rec Arg Run. apply (Safe recv a r); auto.
      eapply DenotesUpcast; [exact Rec|]. apply SubBClass. eapply SubCInh; eassumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_transport_class c d :
  ls_ancestor c d ->
  forall m ps t rt recv a,
  mtype(m,d) = ps ~> t ~> rt ->
  Denotes (TRefn (TNom (TClass c)) ps) recv ->
  Denotes (tsubBV recv t) a ->
  exists qs u ru, mtype(m,c) = qs ~> u ~> ru /\\
    Denotes (TRefn (TNom (TClass c)) qs) recv /\\
    Denotes (tsubBV recv u) a /\\
    (forall r, Denotes (ls_result recv a ru) r -> Denotes (ls_result recv a rt) r).
Proof.
  intro P; induction P; intros m ps t rt recv arg M R A.
  - exists ps, t, rt; auto.
  - assert (Super : Denotes (TRefn (TNom (TClass d)) ps) recv).
    { eapply DenotesUpcast; [exact R|]. apply SubBClass. eapply SubCInh; eassumption. }
    destruct (IHP _ _ _ _ _ _ M Super A) as [qs [u [ru [Mt [Rec [Arg Ret]]]]]].
    assert (Child : Denotes (TRefn (TNom (TClass c)) qs) recv).
    { eapply ls_denotes_change; [exact R|eapply ls_denotes_preds; exact Rec]. }
    destruct (find m ms) as [[[rt' m' ps' t'] body]|] eqn:F.
    + pose proof (ls_find_key _ _ _ F) as K'. change (m' = m) in K'; subst m'.
      pose proof (ls_method_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H F) as OK.
      inversion OK; subst.
      match goal with O : override m c _ ps' t' rt' |- _ =>
        destruct (O _ _ _ Mt) as [SP [SA SR]]
      end.
      exists ps', t', rt'. split; [eapply mty_ok; eassumption|].
      split.
      * exact (ls_sem_sub _ _ _ SP CEmpty recv DEmp Child).
      * split.
        -- eapply ls_sem_under; eassumption.
        -- intros r R'. apply Ret. eapply ls_sem_under2; eassumption.
    + exists qs, u, ru; repeat split; auto. eapply mty_no_override; eassumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_interface_implementation c i m ps t rt :
  Class_implemented c i -> mtypei(m,i) = ps ~> t ~> rt ->
  implement c m rt ps t.
Proof.
  intros C M; inversion C; subst; inversion M; subst.
  match goal with A : find ?i RefIT = Some _, B : find ?i RefIT = Some _ |- _ =>
    rewrite A in B; injection B; intros; subst
  end. eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma ls_transport_signature n m ps t rt c es a :
  ls_sig m n ps t rt ->
  Denotes (TRefn (TNom n) ps) (ExpNew c es) ->
  Denotes (tsubBV (ExpNew c es) t) a ->
  exists qs u ru, mtype(m,c) = qs ~> u ~> ru /\\
    Denotes (TRefn (TNom (TClass c)) qs) (ExpNew c es) /\\
    Denotes (tsubBV (ExpNew c es) u) a /\\
    (forall r, Denotes (ls_result (ExpNew c es) a ru) r ->
               Denotes (ls_result (ExpNew c es) a rt) r).
Proof.
  intros M R A.
  pose proof (ls_object_down _ _ _ _ R) as D.
  destruct (ls_object_info _ _ R) as [d [ds [fs [E [P _]]]]].
  inversion E; subst. apply ls_class_cases in P.
  destruct M as [m s ps t rt M|m i ps t rt M].
  - eapply ls_transport_class; eassumption.
  - destruct P as [s [P Impl]].
    destruct (ls_interface_implementation _ _ _ _ _ _ Impl M)
      as [qs [u [ru [Mt [SP [SA SR]]]]]].
    assert (R' : Denotes (TRefn (TNom (TClass s)) ps) (ExpNew d ds)).
    { eapply DenotesUpcast; [exact D|now apply ls_anc_sub]. }
    pose proof (ls_sem_sub _ _ _ SP CEmpty _ DEmp R') as Rec.
    pose proof (ls_sem_under _ _ _ SA _ _ R' A) as Arg.
    assert (D' : Denotes (TRefn (TNom (TClass d)) qs) (ExpNew d ds)).
    { eapply ls_denotes_change; [exact D|eapply ls_denotes_preds; exact Rec]. }
    destruct (ls_transport_class _ _ P _ _ _ _ _ _ Mt D' Arg)
      as [p' [t' [rt' [Mt' [Rec' [Arg' Ret]]]]]].
    exists p', t', rt'; repeat split; auto.
    intros r Res. eapply ls_sem_under2; [exact SR|exact R'|exact A|auto].
Qed.
EOF
sed -i 's/"'^Local Inductive ls_sig/Inductive ls_sig/'"' Task.v
make >/tmp/rfj-make 2>&1; tail -28 /tmp/rfj-make"
